loam.recommendation: Ideal agricultural soil. Maintain organic matter through regular compost additions and standard balanced NPK fertilization.

crops.name: Tomatoes
crops.fert: Balanced NPK (14-14-14) during vegetative stage; high potassium during fruiting.

crops.name: Lettuce
crops.fert: Nitrogen-rich organic fertilizer; frequent light watering.

crops.name: Carrots
crops.fert: Low nitrogen, high phosphorus and potassium to encourage root development.

crops.name: Peppers
crops.fert: Side-dress with balanced fertilizer when first flowers appear.

clay.recommendation: Heavy texture. Incorporate coarse organic matter and gypsum to improve aeration, drainage, and prevent waterlogging.

crops.name: Rice
crops.fert: Split application of nitrogen (Urea) at tillering and panicle initiation.

crops.name: Broccoli
crops.fert: High nitrogen and boron requirements to prevent hollow stem.

crops.name: Cabbage
crops.fert: Regular nitrogen top-dressing during early head formation.

crops.name: Spinach
crops.fert: Nitrogen-focused fertilizer for lush green leaf growth.

sandy.recommendation: Incorporate high amounts of decomposed organic manure, green manures, and heavy mulch layers to trap moisture and nutrients.

crops.name: Peanuts
crops.fert: Low nitrogen; apply phosphorus and potassium at planting.

crops.name: Watermelon
crops.fert: High potassium and balanced NPK during vine elongation.

crops.name: Sweet Potato
crops.fert: Moderate potassium; avoid excessive nitrogen to prevent vine overgrowth.

crops.name: Legumes
crops.fert: Inoculate seeds with Rhizobium; minimal nitrogen required.

silt.recommendation: Prone to crusting if left bare. Use organic cover crops and avoid heavy machinery when wet to preserve smooth crumb structure.

crops.name: Corn
crops.season: Start of Wet or Dry Season
crops.fert: High nitrogen demand split into basal and side-dress applications.

crops.name: Wheat
crops.fert: Balanced NPK with targeted nitrogen at tillering.

crops.name: Soybeans
crops.fert: Phosphorus and Potassium focused; fixes own nitrogen.

crops.name: Squash
crops.fert: Generous organic compost and balanced NPK fertilizer.
